import inspect

import solution


def test_issue_example_given_in_issue():
    """Issue example asserts ratio for the sample list is 0.15."""
    # 2 zeroes / 13 items = 0.15384... -> rounded to 2 decimals = 0.15
    assert solution.zero_count([0, 1, 2, -1, -5, 6, 0, -3, -2, 3, 4, 6, 8]) == 0.15


def test_issue_no_zeroes_gives_zero():
    """Ratio of zeroes is zero when the list contains no zeroes."""
    # 0 zeroes / 3 items = 0.0
    assert solution.zero_count([1, 2, 3]) == 0.0


def test_issue_all_zeroes_gives_one():
    """Ratio of zeroes is one when every element is zero."""
    # 3 zeroes / 3 items = 1.0
    assert solution.zero_count([0, 0, 0]) == 1.0


def test_issue_single_zero_element():
    """Ratio of zeroes in single-element zero list is one."""
    # 1 zero / 1 item = 1.0
    assert solution.zero_count([0]) == 1.0


def test_issue_single_nonzero_element():
    """Ratio of zeroes in single-element nonzero list is zero."""
    # 0 zeroes / 1 item = 0.0
    assert solution.zero_count([5]) == 0.0


def test_issue_half_zeroes():
    """Ratio of zeroes is half when half the elements are zero."""
    # 2 zeroes / 4 items = 0.5
    assert solution.zero_count([0, 0, 1, 1]) == 0.5


def test_issue_quarter_with_negatives():
    """Only exact zeroes count, negatives are not zeroes."""
    # 1 zero / 4 items = 0.25
    assert solution.zero_count([0, -1, -5, 6]) == 0.25


def test_issue_rounds_up_to_two_decimals():
    """Ratio is rounded to two decimals, rounding up."""
    # 1 zero / 6 items = 0.1666... -> rounded to 2 decimals = 0.17
    assert solution.zero_count([0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]) == 0.17


def test_contract_returns_float():
    """Function finds a ratio, so result is a float."""
    result = solution.zero_count([0, 1])
    # 1 zero / 2 items = 0.5
    assert isinstance(result, float)


def test_contract_takes_single_argument():
    """Public interface defines zero_count(nums) with one parameter."""
    sig = inspect.signature(solution.zero_count)
    assert len(sig.parameters) == 1
